entrance: In the canals of Stormwind City, near the Mage Quarter, at /way 50.4 66.2. Stairs lead down to the portal, with Warden Thelwater just outside.

377.objective: Bring the hand of Dextren Ward to Councilman Millstipe in Darkshire.

387.objective: Kill 10 Defias Prisoners, 8 Defias Convicts and 8 Defias Insurgents.

388.note: Every kind of Defias prisoner drops them, and so do Bazil Thredd, Bruegal Ironknuckle and Dextren Ward.

378.objective: Kill Kam Deepfury and bring his head to Motley Garmason at Dun Modr.

391.objective: Kill Bazil Thredd and bring his head to Warden Thelwater.
